version: acceptance v1 DRAFT (2026-10-25); frozen copy am3_acceptance_v1.json is written by am3_freeze.py before held-out evaluation
note: Replaces the v2 gate (am_acceptance_v1.json): no alignment/pointing criterion, no force-target band, no 1.5 F* rule, no three-second dwell. Thresholds are derived from the task, not from controller results: base 20 mm = 1/15 of the 0.3 m reach and about the pad compression range (12 mm radius) scale; pad tracking 3 mm = quarter of the pad radius; endpoint 5 mm; coverage within 5 mm; force peak 4 N = pad compression limit (6 mm x 600 N/m = 3.6 N, rounded); rotor reserve 0.3 N each side of [0.1, 10] N; tilt 15 deg = NMPC constraint.
